gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-lexend-deca: Ethnocentric stretches its letters wide apart, with short ascenders perched over big bowls, and it looks like it is already moving. Lexend Deca stays plain and approachable beneath it.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-liter: Fast and sharp, Ethnocentric spreads out its wide-set letters over big bowls, while Liter gives it a modern plain sans partner with no stroke contrast. One shouts, the other keeps pace.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-mada: Mada reads approachable and modern, with curves that stay open and a midzone that towers over each word. Ethnocentric, the aggressive display heading, gives that sans-serif a loud, speedy front door.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-martel-sans: Aggressive and quick, Ethnocentric pushes its letters apart over big bowls and short ascenders. And Martel Sans follows in a neutral register, its curves opening generously under a high mean line.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-matangi: Matangi runs a hefty lowercase with rounded letters left open. Beneath Ethnocentric's sprawl, a long paragraph in it should feel contemporary and steady, its line width the same in curves and straights.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-maven-pro: Ethnocentric arrives fast and aggressive, with short ascenders over big bowls and letters pushed well apart from each other. Maven Pro, a modern sans with a gentle monotone line, would read smoothly over a long passage.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-michroma: Professional and modern, Michroma gives each letter a wide berth, so Ethnocentric's aggressive spacing finds an echo below it. Both stay loose and open, with the sans-serif body's tall lowercase and stubby ascender tips set against the heading's short ascenders.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-miriam-libre: Approachable and modern, the body font has a wire-light line and an s with generous openings. Miriam Libre would read smoothly across a long passage, a plain sans that never fights Ethnocentric's speed.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-mochiy-pop-on: Ethnocentric is fast and aggressive, all short ascenders and spread-out letters. It excels at speed and attitude, while Mochiy Pop One, the neutral sans-serif, does its best work with a very large lowercase eye.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-mochiy-pop-p-: Ethnocentric looks fast and aggressive, with short ascenders over big bowls and letters pushed apart. Mochiy Pop P One, a clean sans-serif with a sizable lowercase, holds the same wide-open spacing.
